evidence.crk_forbidden: Persist evidence payloads or replace ledger, case, cognition, or knowledge authorities.
evidence.crk_role: Require evidence and provenance references where constitutional contracts demand them.
evidence.existing_owner: Multiple strong owner candidates require constitutional review.

governance.crk_forbidden: Replace Council, Conclave, cases, missions, security, or existing governance services.
governance.crk_role: Require governance evidence when admission or mutation policy demands it.

identity.crk_forbidden: Generate domain-specific identifiers or own application entity models.
identity.crk_role: Require stable, nonblank constitutional identifiers during capability admission.

lifecycle.crk_forbidden: Execute lifecycle operations already owned by runtime and application managers.

ownership.crk_forbidden: Replace governance authorities or perform domain authorization.
ownership.crk_role: Enforce unique constitutional ownership during capability admission.
ownership.existing_owner: Multiple strong owner candidates require constitutional review.

policy.crk_forbidden: Own business rules, application policy, or security-domain policy.
policy.crk_role: Evaluate a minimal immutable set of kernel admission invariants.

registration.crk_forbidden: Create a second service, application, runtime, or civilization registry.
registration.crk_role: Apply constitutional admission checks before delegating registration to the existing owner.

replay.crk_forbidden: Become a second event bus, ledger, history, timeline, or replay store.
replay.crk_role: Require replay declarations and publish admission events through existing authorities.

validation.crk_forbidden: Absorb domain validation or application-level business validation.
validation.crk_role: Compose bounded invariant checks and produce typed admission results.

does_not_own: Lifecycle execution already owned by runtime and application managers.
